correctness.coverage: FP32/FP16; K=1/2; empty batch; empty experts; skew; odd H

block_demo.benchmark_note: functional MoE block only; no block/model speedup claimed

method.timing: CUDA-event GPU stream elapsed time; per-call samples after warmup. Both paths reuse workspaces; count reset is timed. Compilation, input generation, router, validation, and expert computation are excluded. Small cases include launch gaps.
method.scope: Dispatch/combine transport only, FP16 inputs with FP32 weighted accumulation. The reference uses GPU sorting, indexing, multiplication and reduction; CUDA uses atomic slot assignment, a tiny expert scan, row packing and fused weighted gather. The separate MoE block checks forward correctness; no model/block speedup is claimed. Workspace bytes are explicit persistent buffers, not peak CUDA allocator usage. No comparison to NVIDIA/other production MoE libraries has been run.
